authors.name: WangNan
authors.bio: WangNan is a software engineer and indie founder. He maintains PLAY HYPE GAMES, writes its game notes and checks the catalogue's embeds and metadata; he is not a game developer.
longBio: WangNan is a software engineer and indie founder. He maintains PLAY HYPE GAMES, writes its game notes, and checks the catalogue's embeds and metadata before a page is treated as reviewed.

At Uncorne he works on Next.js SaaS starters with real billing, row-level security and machine-readable docs. His writing on make1day.dev is built against working code, and the same rule applies here: label what was checked, and say what was not.
